# Design Polish

Use this skill after the UI is already functionally complete.

## Workflow

1. Read [../mui-v6-design/SKILL.md](../mui-v6-design/SKILL.md) first, then [references/polish-checklist.md](references/polish-checklist.md).
2. If a recent design critique exists, use it to drive the polish pass.
3. Make surgical, high-value changes:
   - spacing and alignment
   - page headers and action grouping
   - surface treatment and density
   - status chips, helper copy, and empty/loading states
4. Do not introduce broad rewrites or new abstractions unless repeated polish needs justify them.
5. End with a short summary of what was tightened and what still remains rough.

## When To Use

- After template generation plus follow-up UI customization
- After medium or large UI edits when the result works but lacks refinement
- Before `code-review` on design-heavy work
- User explicitly asks to polish, refine, elevate, or make the UI feel more designed
